receipt.result_detail: real-speech portfolio (families: dense4, sparse10, hier2, fixed_diff, lpc, lpc_bidir, lattice, polezero, ngsa) over 8 effectiveness + 8 held-out Mode-C clips, paired against FLAC-5 with exact Wilcoxon signed-rank and a deterministic bootstrap median CI; result sha256 e8f110f683771a42d05c4836ea3483595ec4cc1712fc440273a71f228ad55e11
limitations: learned prediction is an experimental profile: it does not change u1/v1, the literal fallback remains mandatory, and negative learned results are preserved rather than hidden
object-specific fitting is representation selection, never a generalization claim
the portfolio grows one seal at a time; this receipt names its active set

method.sample_domain: sign-extended i16 in i32 (the Seal-K experimental domain)
method.baseline: the wired three-family Exp2 real-speech portfolio
method.attribution: per-family standalone bytes are reported for every clip

protocol.semantic_authority: none: a learned hypothesis is a candidate family, never truth; scalar exact closure decides acceptance
